However, when trying to set the `load` field on the `item = D(save='X', load='Y')` line, a `KeyError` is raised because the class `D` does not support the `load` field. This issue arises from the way the metaclass and inheritance are handled in Scrapy, where fields defined in parent classes are not automatically inherited or merged when creating new subclasses.

To fix this issue, you should ensure that the fields defined in parent classes are properly inherited by their subclasses. One potential solution is to override the `__init_subclass__` method in the base class `Item` to merge fields from parent classes into the subclass.

scrapy.item.Item.__init_subclass__
```
